notes.title: Update 1.4.0 BETA is Live! 🚀
notes.notes:
Hey Poly Plaza Community! 🎉

I’m super excited to announce that [b]Update 1.4.0 BETA[/b] is now live! 🚀 This update is all about enhancing your experience, adding exciting new features, and fixing some of those pesky bugs. Your support and feedback have been amazing—thanks to you, we’re making Poly Plaza better every day. 💪

So, what’s new? Let’s get into it!

[h1]🔥 [b]New Features[/b] 🔥[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Garages [/b]🚗—Finally! You can now access your purchased vehicles from garages placed around the world (like at car dealers). It’s going to make managing your fleet so much easier!
[*] [b]Massive Performance Boost[/b] 💨—I’ve worked hard on optimizing the game, and now it runs way smoother! No more lag!
[*] [b]World Enhancements[/b] 🌍—I’ve added more detailed environments and interactive objects to make the world feel even more alive. Go check it out!
[/list]

[h1]🛠️[b] Fixes and System Updates [/b]🛠️[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Property Reset[/b] 🏘️—To improve performance, all purchased properties have been reset. But don’t worry—you’ll keep your levels, XP, money, vehicles, and items! Your progress is safe! 💰
[*] [b]Vehicle Rework[/b] 🚙—Driving just got a whole lot better! I’ve improved vehicle handling and added fresh engine sounds, so your rides feel smoother and more realistic.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes[/b] 🐛—I’ve crushed a bunch of bugs, including disappearing objects, invisible walls, and improved support for non-Latin languages. The world should feel a lot more stable now!
[/list]

This update is still in [b]BETA[/b], so you might run into a few bugs here and there. But I’m rolling out daily updates to keep things smooth and fresh, and more content is on the way!

Thank you again for sticking with me and helping me shape Poly Plaza into something great. I’ve got even bigger things planned—like [b]multiplayer [/b]and[b] new gameplay features[/b]—so stay tuned! 💖

notes.title: Update 1.3.7 is here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I'm excited to announce the release of the 1.3.7 update! This update introduces some cool new features and hints at an even bigger future for Poly Plaza.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Car Color Customization[/b] - You can now change the color of your car when purchasing it! Show off your style with a fresh paint job. 🚗✨
[*] [b]Shop UI Rework[/b] - The shop UI has been completely revamped to make browsing and buying smoother. 🛒
[*] [b]Poly Plaza Toolkit[/b] - I’m thrilled to introduce the Poly Plaza Toolkit! Right now, it’s used to launch the game and better integrate with my Twitch channel, victorsgameventure. While it’s not yet ready for modding, this is just the beginning. Soon, you’ll be able to create and share mods easily!
[/list]

This update is setting the stage for what’s to come. Your support has been incredible, and I’m excited to see where we go from here.

[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]
The Poly Plaza Toolkit is just getting started. Modding support is on the horizon, giving you the power to reshape your Poly Plaza experience. Stay tuned for more updates!

Thanks for being such an awesome community. Your feedback is what keeps me pushing forward. ❤️

See you in the Plaza!

notes.title: Update 1.2 is finally here!

I'm excited to announce the release of the 1.2 update! This update brings a variety of new features and improvements, and I've created a short YouTube video to showcase what's new:
